name: Ishikawa Goemon
source:
A ninja that is the princess's childhood friend.
After his clan was destroyed he considers the princess to be his only family and he worries about her more than anyone.
He's strong but has a bad mouth.
His duty is to sneak into enemies castles and obtain important information.
